messages:
Maria: FYI I cut rc build rc-2026-03-23-mercury (sha: 8f4b2d) for the conversational-inference service.
Maria: Release notes: small prompt fix for truncation, routing fallback polish, and perf regressions fixed for short-context requests. Full notes in PR: https://git.internal/r/3412
Maria: Planning to promote to prod in the 2h change window starting 2026-03-23T22:00Z. Need QA + oncall signoff, and a pinned artifact for the promo.
Leo: Thanks. Can you confirm the canary plan?
Maria: Canary plan: 2% traffic -> 10% after 15m -> 50% after 45m if metrics ok. Region by region: start in us-west1 only.
Leo: OK. I'll request pin and trigger deploy-bot once QA ack. Checklist: smoke, kv-cache warm, telemetry gates, release note posted.
Sam (QA): Running smoke now against rc-2026-03-23-mercury. I'll post results in ~10m.
deploy-bot: scheduled artifact pin request for rc-2026-03-23-mercury at 2026-03-23T20:30:00Z. pin-id: pin-72f1
Sam (QA): Smoke: passed basic generation, rerank sanity, and rate-limited paths. Failing one e2e on long-history truncation (investigating).
Maria: Noted. That truncation test matches the PR change; if it's within expected behavior we can include a note, otherwise gate. Sam please paste failing log.
Sam (QA): Log snippet: ```ERROR: conversation_truncate: token_overflow at 512 -> occurred intermittently```
Leo: We need to decide: proceed with canary but exclude long-history endpoints, or wait for hotfix. My vote: exclude route /client-v1/history until we patch.
Jin (oncall): Heads up: we have a telemetry blackout in eu-central at 2026-03-23T23:30Z for infra maintenance. If canary crosses into that window we'll lose some metrics. Recommend starting now and finishing before the blackout or delaying to after.
Maria: Good catch. Let's start the change window at 22:00Z as planned — that finishes before the eu maintenance.
Leo: Action items: Maria to pin artifact (deploy-bot), Sam to re-run smoke excluding history route, Jin to be oncall and watch ERR spikes, I will start canary and monitor latency/error dashboards.
deploy-bot: pin applied: pin-72f1 -> rc-2026-03-23-mercury (sha: 8f4b2d). Canary job created: job-8842. Canary schedule: 2026-03-23T22:00Z us-west1 2%
Maria: Release notes pushed to /docs/releases/rc-2026-03-23-mercury.md and emailed to eng-release list.
Sam (QA): Re-run smoke excluding /client-v1/history: all green. No regression on short-context perf.
Leo: Approve from release side. Jin - toggles and rollback plan?
Jin (oncall): I'll be online at the start. Rollback plan: if error rate > 1.5x baseline for 10m or P95 latency increases > 40% for 10m, we abort and rollback to previous pinned sha 7c3a1b. Rollback command: ```# deploy-bot rollback job
deploy-bot promote --target sha=7c3a1b --scope=us-west1 --reason="auto-rollback"```
Maria: Noted. Can we add a manual escape hatch to route traffic away from the canary via traffic-shim?
Leo: Yes, I'll keep the traffic-shim toggle ready. Command: `curl -XPOST https://ops-api/traffic-shim --data '{"service":"conv","region":"us-west1","percent":0}'`
deploy-bot: canary job-8842 will emit status pings to #metrics every 60s.
Sam (QA): Final QA ack: green (with /client-v1/history excluded). Approved to promote.
Maria: All right, promoting to canary at 22:00Z. Posting final checklist: pinned, smoke green, notes published, oncall ready, rollback plan in place.
Leo: I'll kick the promo at T+0 and monitor. If anything weird, call out and we'll roll back. :thumbsup:
Jin (oncall): I'll be watching. If we need to abort, ping @oncall-jin in thread.
deploy-bot: promo started: job-8842 stage=canary percent=2 region=us-west1. status=running
Maria: thanks team. Keeping channel updated with metrics and any manual toggles.
Leo: If canary looks safe at +45m we proceed to ramp to 50% and cross-region.
Sam (QA): I'll keep an eye on regressions and post any anomalies.
Maria: Closing initial thread — will append post-canary readout once we hit the 50% decision point.
deploy-bot: job-8842 heartbeat @ 2026-03-23T22:05:00Z: errors=0, p95=120ms, tokens/sec=4300
Leo: looks healthy so far."
